name: The Outlets at Orange
summary: Tree-lined open-air outlet mall with 25 restaurants, an indoor skate park & an IMAX cinema.
description: The Outlets at Orange is a premier outdoor outlet shopping destination in Orange County, California, offering an exceptional mix of designer and brand-name retailers at outlet prices. This open-air center combines Southern California's ideal weather with a diverse collection of fashion, home, and lifestyle stores, creating an inviting shopping experience for value-conscious consumers.
demographics: The Outlets at Orange attracts a diverse mix of middle to upper-middle income families and bargain hunters from across Orange County and surrounding areas, with primary visitors ranging from 25-55 years old. The trade area encompasses affluent Orange County communities including Anaheim, Tustin, and Irvine, drawing households with median incomes between $75,000-$125,000 who seek brand-name quality at discounted prices. Shoppers typically include suburban families with children, young professionals, and tourists visiting nearby Disneyland Resort who value outlet shopping and are willing to drive 15-30 minutes for significant savings on premium brands.
